page: Microsoft Azure E128nds_v6 is an Endv6-family virtual machine configured with 128 dedicated vCPUs on an x86_64 Intel processor architecture. The instance runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and features 1024.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This server includes 7559 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and supports Premium Storage. Classified as network-optimized, the instance is designed to handle high-throughput network traffic alongside its large local storage capacity. There are no integrated GPUs on this configuration.

Given the high resource density of 1024.0 GB RAM and 7559 GB of fast local NVMe SSD storage, this server offers a specialized hardware profile for memory-intensive and storage-heavy workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance. It is suited for large-scale databases, memory-intensive enterprise applications, and high-throughput data processing tasks that require substantial local scratch space.
